::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[Calculate the $\sup$](https://math.stackexchange.com/questions/4566740/calculate-the-sup), asked by [weymar andres](https://math.stackexchange.com/users/616791/weymar-andres) on Mathematics Stack Exchange (2022-11-01; [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)):

> Let us $A=\{\frac{1}{|\frac{\pi}{2}+2n\pi|}, n\in\mathbb Z \}$, Calculate $\sup A$.
>
> I am confuse, because $n\in\mathbb Z$ then for me i need to find the infimum of $|\frac{\pi}{2}+2n\pi|$ that it goes to $\infty$ implies that $\sup A= 0$ right?
>
> I thought well? or i am wrong?
>
> Thank you
:::

Notice that
$$\frac{1}{\left| \frac{\pi}{2} + 2\pi n \right|}
    = \frac{2}{\left| \pi + 4\pi n \right|}
    = \frac{2}{\pi} \cdot \frac{1}{\left|4n+1\right|}$$
So if you can find the supremum of $\left\{\left|\frac{1}{4n+1}\right|\right\}$, you are finished.
